As AI masters the mechanics of spelling, grammar, and even the reading of pre-drafted scripts, your value shifts toward your ability to curate unique perspectives and engage in spontaneous, high-stakes improvisation. This allows you to spend your energy on the nuances of performance—vocal dynamics, emotional resonance, and building a professional network—that AI cannot replicate. Your week will move away from script preparation toward high-level content strategy and live, unscripted interaction.
